rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to a period of ten years.

example.english: Hong Kong changed a lot during this decade.
example.traditional: 呢個十年香港變化好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sap6 nin4 hoeng1 gong2 bin3 faa3 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this for a named decade such as 六十年代, meaning the 1960s or the culture and events associated with it.

example.english: This film recreates life in Hong Kong during the 1960s, a decade of big changes.
example.traditional: 呢套戲重現咗六十年代嘅香港生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 cung4 jin6 zo2 luk6 sap6 nin4 doi6 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 sang1 wut6
